title: The orphan sweep is wired only at runSidecar startup, so a marker that becomes …
description:
The orphan sweep is wired only at runSidecar startup, so a marker that becomes orphaned mid-session (operator ships/abandons its issue without a fresh sidecar boot) is not swept until the next process start. This satisfies AC6's 'and/or' placement and covers the boot-surface scenario, so it is non-blocking; adding a preflight-start call site would close the mid-session window if desired later.

Source: cam/issue-282
Review round: 1
Location: src/commands/sidecar.ts:2881

suggestion-fingerprint: d03cc5efee80

acceptanceCriteria: sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker is invoked at the start of every plan-phase dispatch (mid-session), before runPlanPreflight, in addition to the existing runSidecar startup call site.
The mid-session sweep uses the existing injectable seam (sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn) and the same read-only-on-main path; it never touches the working tree.
A new wiring test asserts the sweep fires on plan-phase dispatch (the startup and preflight call sites currently have no wiring test).
The existing runSidecar startup call site and the pure-function tests in sidecar-orphan-sweep.test.ts remain unchanged and green.
spec.scope: Add a second call site for sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker at plan-preflight start, inside the closure returned by makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (sidecar.ts:2345-2354), before runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan / runPlanPreflight. Add a wiring test. Do NOT modify the pure sweep function and do NOT add an idle-tick call site.
gotchas: cwd and claudeDir are already in scope at makeProductionPlanPhaseFn; call sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker(join(claudeDir, IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME), cwd).
Preserve the read-only-on-main invariant: readBacklogFromMain uses git ls-tree/cat-file, never checkout/pull/stage.
Scope is preflight-start only; the per-tick circuit-breaker read at loop.ts:2198 is intentionally NOT a new sweep site.
